dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid-pixel high-intensity light clusters distributed along the lateral-anterior and mid-dorsal regions; these clusters appear as asymmetrical, localized patches lacking internal voids or gradients.
